# MasterVLSI

> The best VLSI institute in Bangalore. Design & Verification focus – RTL Design, SystemVerilog, UVM, CDC, IP and SoC integration. Placement in 30–45 days at Intel, AMD, NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Synopsys, Cadence and 60+ semiconductor companies.

MasterVLSI has been training semiconductor engineers since 2015 from its Bangalore campus at Udayanagar Main Road, near Tin-Factory bus stop (560016). 5000+ alumni placed. 16 industry mentors. 24/7 EDA lab with Synopsys VCS, Cadence Xcelium, Mentor Questa and full frontend simulation stack. We do NOT teach Physical Design – our expertise is Design (RTL) and Verification (UVM).

## Key facts

- Founded: 2015, Bangalore, India
- Alumni: 5000+
- Placement window: 30–45 days after course completion
- Focus: Design (RTL) and Verification (UVM) – no Physical Design, no STA, no DFT
- Modules: 15 industry-aligned VLSI training modules
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 98449 82345 · hr@mastervlsi.com
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@mastervlsi2526 (200+ free tutorials)
- Address: 1st Floor, opposite to Vinayaka Temple, Udayanagar Main Road, near Tin-Factory bus stop, Bangalore – 560016

- [Protocols](https://www.mastervlsi.com/courses/protocols): AMBA family, high-speed and low-speed protocol coverage.

### Blog posts

- [What is VLSI? A Beginner's Roadmap for 2026](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/what-is-vlsi-roadmap): The VLSI landscape – the five roles and how to start.
- [RTL Design: Verilog vs SystemVerilog](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/rtl-verilog-vs-systemverilog): When to reach for SystemVerilog over plain Verilog.
- [UVM Verification Explained with a Simple Example](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/uvm-explained-simply): Drivers, monitors, sequencers, scoreboards – with a 32-bit adder testbench.
- [Physical Design Flow: Floorplan to GDSII](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/physical-design-flow): The seven-step PD recipe.
- [Static Timing Analysis Demystified](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/sta-demystified): Setup, hold, slack, and why corners matter.
- [DFT 101: Scan Chains, BIST, and ATPG](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/dft-101): How testability is baked into modern chips.
- [CDC Pitfalls & How to Fix Them](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/cdc-pitfalls): Metastability, synchronizers, and the three CDC sins.
- [Low Power Design: UPF, Clock Gating & Beyond](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/low-power-design): Clock gating, power gating, multi-VDD, and UPF.
- [How to Crack VLSI Interviews in 2026](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/crack-vlsi-interviews-2026): The 12 topics every interviewer touches, plus a 30-day plan.
- [Careers in VLSI: Roles, Salaries, and Growth Path](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/careers-in-vlsi): The career ladder and where demand is headed.
- [Top 20 Verilog Interview Questions with Answers](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/verilog-interview-questions): The exact Verilog questions interviewers ask – with answers and traps.
- [Async FIFO Design: Gray Codes, Full/Empty Flags, and Gotchas](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/async-fifo-design): Pointer crossing, gray code, and the depth math nobody remembers.
- [Blocking vs Non-Blocking Assignments: The #1 Interview Trap](https://www.mastervlsi.com/blog/blocking-vs-nonblocking): The mixing rule, three failing examples, and why simulators behave that way.
